sub: Data, key, metadata and version ID.

Overview.p: An object is a file stored in S3: data, a key, metadata and an optional version ID. A single object can be up to 5 TB.
One file in your locker with a label and notes attached.
A photo app stores each upload as an object and uses metadata to remember the user and file type.

items: You upload data with a key
S3 stores the data and metadata
Each version has a version ID
